So learning to market these days means learning to set up an agent with your data, creative tools and ad accounts.

Set it up right and you get a top 0.1% marketer testing an absurd number of ideas every day: https://t.co/64vZyolTFP https://t.co/pyXGW79Qrh

What's easier than trying to build a giant furniture library?

Letting users just upload their own furniture they want as a photo and then turn it into a 3d object in less than 30 seconds with an image-to-3d model ofcourse! https://t.co/n878FlRw7Z https://t.co/XDStwhZBuZ
posts.text_zh:
还有什么比试图建一个巨大的家具库更简单呢？

让用户把自己想要的家具拍成照片上传，然后用 image-to-3d 模型在不到 30 秒内把它变成 3D 物体，当然啦！ https://t.co/n878FlRw7Z https://t.co/XDStwhZBuZ

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早的进度更新：把整个 @IKEA 的 3D 目录导入了 Interior AI，现在可以导入户型图或漫游视频来重建房子并重新装修。

quoted.text:
✨ Progress update:

I imported the entire catalogue of @IKEA in 3d into Interior AI after seeing someone do the same yesterday, I'll try to import more furniture brands soon to get more variety too

Anyway so now you can import your home's blueprint or do a walk through video, it then rebuilds your home, and then you can redecorate it

This is now day 4 of rebuilding Interior AI now that's the models are smart enough to do 3d stuff properly, it still looks a bit clunky and all but it's going somewhere! 😊
quoted.text_zh:
✨ 进度更新：

看到有人昨天也这么做之后，我把整个 @IKEA 的 3D 目录导入了 Interior AI，之后还会再导入更多家具品牌，好增加多样性

总之，现在你可以导入家里的户型图，或者拍一段漫游视频，它就会重建你的家，然后你就可以重新装修了

现在是重建 Interior AI 的第 4 天，因为模型已经足够聪明，能把 3D 的事情做像样了，看起来还是有点笨拙，但已经在往前走了！😊

quoted.text:
More progress!

Interior AI 3D works with "just" a floor plan now

Not much information to work with and it has to imagine furniture etc. but it works

Some weird things like the big I guess sliding windows to outdoor garden are missing, and bath tub is just a box, and I don't see a toilet seat etc. so we need it to become a bit more granular/specific/advanced

But it's very promising

It was really impossible until recently do to floor plan to 3d automatically and properly!
quoted.text_zh:
又有进展了！

现在 Interior AI 3D 只靠一张平面图就能工作了

可用的信息并不多，还得自己想象家具之类的东西，但已经能跑起来了

有些地方比较怪，比如通往户外花园的那些大概是落地推拉窗的部分缺失了，浴缸只是一个方盒子，也看不到马桶盖等等，所以还需要做得更细致、更具体、更高级一些

不过非常有前景

直到最近，从平面图自动、准确地生成 3D，其实都是不可能的！

posts.text:
All the people on here always tell me for years "nooooo you can't just ship solo and have high uptime like big companies"

And it's just not true, because big companies like Revolut even make stupid mistakes like not having monitoring working on their main production databases! And big companies go down all the time as you saw with Microsoft this week too

The point being is that anyone can go down, and it's pretty equal for a well managed solo founder as it is for a big company
posts.text_zh:
这么多年来，这里总有人跟我说「不行啊，你不能只靠一个人上线，还指望有大公司那样的高可用性」

这根本不是真的，因为像 Revolut 这样的大公司也会犯低级错误，比如主力生产数据库根本没有监控！而且大公司也经常宕机，这周 Microsoft 的情况你们也看到了

关键在于，谁都可能挂掉；一个管理得当的独立开发者，和一个大公司，其实差不多

引用内容：他引用了 @GergelyOrosz 的帖子：Revolut 公布了一次长达 5 小时的全球卡片服务故障复盘，指出数据库节点宕机没有监控，且跨 3 个区域只跑了 5 个节点，单节点故障就没有可用区韧性。

quoted.text:
Revolut shared the postmortem of their global cards outage of 5 hours. Some interesting (alarming?) notes:

1. They had no monitoring on database nodes going down (!!)

2. Across 3 regions, they ran 5 nodes, with #1. So a single node going down meant no zonal resillience (cont'd) https://t.co/XG8ocvmPKC https://t.co/qe2ZQmZUw7
quoted.text_zh:
Revolut 公布了他们长达 5 小时的全球卡片服务故障复盘。一些有意思（也令人担忧？）的要点：

1. 他们在数据库节点宕机时没有任何监控（！！）

2. 跨 3 个区域只跑了 5 个节点，再加上第 1 点。所以单个节点宕机就意味着没有可用区韧性（未完） https://t.co/XG8ocvmPKC https://t.co/qe2ZQmZUw7
